Choose what this app is told about location, Bluetooth and battery restrictions

Make selected checks inside this app report an enabled or unrestricted state. This can help with permission prompts, but apps may use other checks too. Your real settings, permissions and location stay the same.
Settings that really change app behaviour
Tell the app Bluetooth is on when it checks. Does not turn on Bluetooth, connect devices or allow scanning.
Tell the app location and existing location providers are enabled. Does not turn on location, provide a fix or change your coordinates.
Pretend location is allowed all the time
Tell the app its background-location permission is granted when it checks itself. Does not let it access location in the background. Location access while using the app must already be allowed.
Unavailable: this app does not request the background-location permission.
Unavailable: first allow location while using this app in App permissions.
Tell the app it is exempt from Android battery optimization. Android can still limit it when the phone is idle.
Tell the app it is not background-restricted. Does not remove background limits or keep the app running.
Tell the app it is not inactive and its standby bucket is Active. Android still uses its real bucket for jobs, alarms and background limits.

Never: return the real state.
Always: use the pretend state whenever the app checks.
While active: apply while Android considers the app foreground, including foreground services.
While in Recents: apply while any of its tasks remain in Recents, even after leaving the app. Swipe them all away to stop.

These rules do not launch the app or keep it alive. An app may need reopening if it remembers an earlier check.
Could not save the spoofed state. No new setting was applied.
Open Android battery settings to change this app’s real background limits. Choosing Unrestricted can increase battery use.
Really stop PetalPower from restricting this app when the screen is off. Other Android limits, manually blocked network access and phone-wide scanning settings still apply.
Some earlier PetalPower restrictions could not be removed. Turn the screen on or change this switch again to retry.
